$comment: Architecture candidate only. Schema validation is followed by typed range, cross-field and authority validation. Not a public v1 SDK.

BoundedUntrustedJson.description: Purpose-specific untrusted JSON: at most512KiB,depth64,nodes10000; descriptor payloads additionally require declared schema validation before use. Not an operation or authority escape hatch.

Counter.description: Canonical decimal 0..9223372036854775807. Typed range validation required.

EventRevisionKind.description:
The revision dimension of an [`Event`]'s aggregate: the recorded [`RevisionKind`] values
plus, from schema revision 2, `Command` for a command aggregate ([`EventSubject::Command`]).
Separate from [`RevisionKind`] so that revision conflicts, which never concern a command, keep
their recorded shape at every revision.

oneOf.description: Schema revision 2: the only revision (1) of a decided command.

EventSubject.description:
The aggregate an [`Event`] is about: the recorded [`Subject`] variants plus, from schema
revision 2, the command (receipt) itself, for a decision whose command names no existing work
item or durable operation. A separate union from [`Subject`] so that blockers and revision
conflicts, which can never name a command, keep their recorded shape at every revision.

oneOf.description: Schema revision 2: the decided command; its revision is always 1 (a receipt is immutable).

GraphUnitKey.description: Exact canonical indexed unit: / for root, /path for a directory, or a relative file path; no backslashes, drive prefixes, empty/dot/dot-dot segments or NUL.

checkpoint.description: Schema revision 2: the continuation checkpoint (present on every revision-2 page).
